messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Hosted API us-west-2 queue depth rising. p95=1.2s p99=11.6s, error rate 4.7%. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions; last failure: quota_exceeded from cloud provider. Paging primary oncall.
Monica (oncall): on it. joining call now. any customer-facing impact yet?
Maya (support): multiple customers reporting timeouts and slow responses, some 504s. Support ticket queue has 12 related tickets, highest priority customer A has a degraded experience.
Neha (eng-sre): seeing GPU pool saturations on pool-gw-west-2. All T4pools at 100% and pending creations failing with 403 QuotaExceeded. Logs show scale requests throttled by provider API.
Ryan (engineer): checking autoscaler logs — it tried to create 6 instances in last 5m. 3 created, 3 failed with: 
```
ERROR cloud: quota limit reached: Requested vGPUs (12) exceed quota (8) for project redwood-prod-west
```
Monica (oncall): ok. immediate mitigations? can we fall back to lower-memory models or spill to other regions?
Neha (eng-sre): we have two levers: 1) Route low-priority traffic to smaller model-variants (gptj-6b-quant) in same region to reduce vGPU memory. 2) Route burst traffic to eu-west-1 (cross-region) but will add latency for EU customers. Also cache warm prefixes to reduce token churn.
Ryan (engineer): I can flip a routing rule to degrade non-premium routes to quantized variants. pushing patch to router: 
```
# quick patch
route.match: path.startsWith('/v1/generate') && !request.headers['x-customer-tier']=='enterprise'
route.backend: model-variant/gptj-6b-quant
```
Monica (oncall): do it, but add header so we can measure fallout. tag traffic as fallback-2487.
Ryan (engineer): deploying now. patch applied. :rocket: routing change live — redirecting ~28% of incoming requests to quantized variant.
Ops-Bot: :white_check_mark:  routing-change applied by Ryan at 2487654403. Telemetry: fallback-2487 label attached.
Neha (eng-sre): monitoring queues — total queue depth dropped from 18k -> 9k in 90s. p99 dropped to 6.8s. error rate trending down. Good immediate effect.
Maya (support): sending customer A an acknowledgement with workaround (set model param to a smaller variant) and ETA for follow-up.
Zoe (product): please collect which endpoints saw the most fallbacks — want to assess UX impact for premium vs free.
Monica (oncall): next step: try temporary scale-out of dedicated reserved pool? But quota prevents more vGPUs. We can request emergency quota bump but that takes time. Also consider admitting degraded latency SLO to reduce headroom pressure (longer timeouts) — risk of tail latency.
Neha (eng-sre): submitting emergency quota request to cloud console and opening provider chat. Request details: +16 vGPUs for 2 hours, reason: incident 2487654321. I've attached logs. ETA unknown.
Ryan (engineer): another quick mitigation: enable suffix/KV-cache for repeated prompt prefixes on high-traffic routes — can reduce tokens per request ~12%. Enabling now via config flip.
Ops-Bot: :white_check_mark: kv-cache enabled for /v1/chat.generate at 2487654510.
Monica (oncall): telemetry? p95/p99 now?
Neha (eng-sre): p95=0.9s p99=4.1s after both mitigations. Queue depth steady ~7k. Error rate down to 1.1%. Still above normal but improving.
Maya (support): Customer A confirmed partial improvement after suggested temporary param. They're still seeing occasional retries but accepted workaround for now.
Zoe (product): collect examples of any hallucination/regression from lower-tier quantized models — need to track quality regressions tied to fallback-2487 label.
Ryan (engineer): adding an eval hook that samples 1% of fallback-2487 responses and runs quality checks. Also writing logs to dedicated retention so we can rollback if regressions spike.
Monica (oncall): handoff plan: I'm going to stay for next 30m to verify stability. Neha — escalate if quota bump comes through. If not, prepare runbook for longer-term mitigations (rate limit non-critical customers, schedule a controlled degradation window).
Neha (eng-sre): acknowledged. Opening runbook PR with steps: emergency routing, kv-cache, short-term rate limits, cross-region spill, and provider escalation contacts.
Maya (support): updating public status page: note degraded performance for some customers in US-West, we are actively mitigating. Draft message: "We are experiencing increased latencies in US-West. Engineers are actively mitigating; some customers may see degraded performance. Updates every 15 minutes."
Monica (oncall): good. let's post that in 5m. Also call out affected enterprise customers for priority outreach.
Ops-Bot: :information_source: provider-chat created: https://cloudchat.example.com/thread/4321 — ticket id CC-9981.
Neha (eng-sre): provider replied: currently processing quota request; provisional approval pending manual review. No ETA. Also flagged potential global demand surge from customer X pushing a large backfill job.
Ryan (engineer): can we throttle or block that customer X traffic temporarily? How many requests are they sending?
Neha (eng-sre): customer X accounts for ~41% of the current burst, mostly inference-bulk jobs. We can throttle via policy: max_qps 60 for that customer. Want me to apply?
Monica (oncall): apply throttle to customer X now. Mark as emergency rate-limit.
Neha (eng-sre): applied throttle. customer X QPS dropped 78%, overall queue depth fell another 2k. p99 down to 3.3s.
Maya (support): alerted customer X their jobs are being throttled for stability. They acknowledged.
Zoe (product): can we surface the cost / unit implications of moving to quantized variants for internal reporting? want to compare RU savings vs quality.
Ryan (engineer): capturing metrics under fallback-2487: token/savings ~24% lower. will add to incident notes.
Monica (oncall): summary for postmortem: root cause: sudden traffic spike from customer X + provider vGPU quota limits prevented autoscaler from replenishing capacity -> queue growth and p99 blowup. Mitigations: routing fallback to quantized models, kv-cache flip, per-customer throttle, provider quota request. Current status: stable but degraded; monitoring continues.
Neha (eng-sre): preparing incident timeline and attaching autoscaler logs, cloud errors, and routing diff. Will open postmortem ticket after stabilised.
Monica (oncall): handoff to Neha in 40m. if anything degrades, page me back.
Maya (support): continuing customer comms. posting status update now.
Ops-Bot: :white_check_mark: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. tags: fallback-2487, quota-issue, customer-throttle.
Monica (oncall): thanks team. final note before handoff: keep quota escalation open and prepare for controlled maintenance window if quota not granted in 6 hours. Handoff at 2487655000.
Neha (eng-sre): acknowledged. taking lead.
Zoe (product): assigning post-incident tasks: collect fallback-quality evals, update SLA playbook, and review pricing triggers for autoscale emergency.
Monica (oncall): leaving now. handoff complete. :wave:
